description: This file contains unit tests for custom grain placement strategies in an Orleans distributed application. It defines a test class 'CustomPlacementTests' with setup fixtures and multiple test methods that verify different placement strategies such as fixed silo placement, exclusion rules, context-based placement, and hash-based placement.

classes.name: CustomPlacementTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying custom grain placement strategies in Orleans, including fixed silo, exclusion, context-based, and hash-based placements.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_FixedSilo
methods.description: Tests that grains are placed on a fixed silo, specifically the second last silo.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_ExcludeOne
methods.description: Tests that grains are not placed on the excluded silo.

methods.name: CustomPlacement_RequestContextBased
methods.description: Tests that grains are placed on a silo determined by request context, specifically targeting the last silo.

methods.name: HashBasedPlacement
methods.description: Verifies that grains are assigned to silos based on a hash of their IDs, ensuring consistent placement.
